description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/column_nonuniform_1d/rules/sedimentation_upwind1_flux_D_lev: the compound D(W*q, lev) replaced by the rule's makearray (interior donor-cell difference stencil aggregate over [1,7]; the no-inflow top layer k=8 whose outflow is layer 8's own flux alone). Every binding loads fixture.esm (NLEV bound to 8 at the import edge), runs the section-9.6.3 rewrite fixpoint, and must emit a byte-identical expanded AST with zero apply_expression_template nodes (the two grid geometry templates the observeds zc and dz apply to the 9-interface array ze are fully inlined), zero unlowered rewrite-target ops, zero surviving metaparameter names, the free-name geometry array dz surviving as index references and the lev_nodes axis folded to size 9. The golden is generated by the Julia reference runner only (scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh) and compared bytewise by the other bindings.
